maddeler.e:
يخضوضر (form XII)
# يَخْضَوْضِرُ (yaḵḍawḍiru) /jax.dˤaw.dˤi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْضَوْضَرَ (iḵḍawḍara)
# يَخْضَوْضِرَ (yaḵḍawḍira) /jax.dˤaw.dˤi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْضَوْضَرَ (iḵḍawḍara)
# يَخْضَوْضِرْ (yaḵḍawḍir) /jax.dˤaw.dˤir/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِخْضَوْضَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
